description: Scope definitions for every cross-disciplinary extension. Scope membership does not imply implementation, dataset availability, or validation.

Computer science.scope: Algorithms, programming languages, computer architecture, computation theory and scientific software foundations.

Software engineering.scope: Software architecture, development processes, testing, maintenance, reliability and engineering practice.

Data science.scope: Data preparation, exploratory analysis, statistical learning, visualization and reproducible data workflows.

Machine learning.scope: Supervised, unsupervised and reinforcement learning methods, evaluation and deployment research.

Deep learning.scope: Neural network architectures, representation learning, optimization and model evaluation.

Cybersecurity.scope: Threat modelling, secure systems, cryptography, vulnerability analysis and defensive security.

Cloud computing.scope: Cloud infrastructure, elastic compute, managed services, deployment and cost-aware operations.

Distributed systems.scope: Distributed algorithms, consensus, fault tolerance, coordination and scalable services.

Database systems.scope: Data models, query processing, transactions, indexing, storage engines and database reliability.

Information theory.scope: Entropy, coding, compression, information measures and communication limits.

Signal processing.scope: Digital signal analysis, filtering, transforms, time-frequency methods and sensor data.

Control systems.scope: Feedback, system identification, estimation, stability and control design.

Electrical engineering.scope: Circuits, electronics, power systems, embedded hardware and electrical measurement.

Mechanical engineering.scope: Mechanics, machine design, dynamics, manufacturing and mechanical systems.

Chemical engineering.scope: Process design, transport phenomena, reaction engineering and industrial chemistry.

Civil engineering.scope: Structures, geotechnics, construction materials, transport and infrastructure systems.

Aerospace engineering.scope: Aerodynamics, flight mechanics, propulsion, spacecraft and aerospace structures.

Environmental engineering.scope: Pollution control, water/waste systems, remediation and environmental process design.

Materials science.scope: Structure-property relationships, materials synthesis, characterization and performance.

Nanotechnology.scope: Nanoscale fabrication, characterization, devices and nanoscale phenomena.

Robotics.scope: Robot mechanisms, perception, planning, manipulation, autonomy and control.

Mechatronics.scope: Integrated mechanical, electronic, control and embedded-computing systems.

Bioengineering.scope: Engineering analysis and design applied to biological systems and processes.

Computational physics.scope: Numerical simulation, physical modelling, computational methods and reproducible physics.

Applied mathematics.scope: Mathematical modelling, differential equations, optimization and applied analysis.

Statistics.scope: Probability, statistical inference, experimental design, regression and uncertainty quantification.

Operations research.scope: Optimization, decision analysis, scheduling, logistics and mathematical operations models.

Energy systems.scope: Energy conversion, storage, grids, efficiency and integrated energy technologies.

Agricultural science.scope: Crop and animal systems, soil, agronomy, agricultural ecology and production research.

Food science.scope: Food composition, processing, safety, quality, nutrition and food microbiology.

Climate science.scope: Climate processes, variability, change attribution, impacts and projections.

Geoscience.scope: Earth materials, processes, history, resources and geological systems.

Geophysics.scope: Physical properties of Earth, seismic methods, gravity, magnetism and subsurface imaging.

Optical engineering.scope: Optical system design, lenses, imaging, instrumentation and optical metrology.

Photonics.scope: Light generation, manipulation, detection, optical communications and photonic devices.

Quantum computing.scope: Quantum information, algorithms, error correction, hardware and computational complexity.

Human-computer interaction.scope: Interaction design, usability, accessibility, human factors and user evaluation.

Scientific computing.scope: Numerical algorithms, high-performance computing, simulation and reproducible computation.

Computational neuroscience.scope: Mathematical and computational models of neural systems, circuits and cognition.

Medical software engineering.scope: Software lifecycle, verification, safety, usability and quality for medical software.

Reliability engineering.scope: Reliability prediction, failure analysis, maintainability and lifecycle risk.

Safety engineering.scope: Hazard analysis, risk controls, safety cases and system safety assurance.

Industrial engineering.scope: Process optimization, operations, human factors, quality and production systems.

Manufacturing engineering.scope: Manufacturing processes, automation, metrology, production and process quality.

Systems engineering.scope: Requirements, architecture, integration, verification and lifecycle management of complex systems.

Computational chemistry.scope: Molecular modelling, quantum chemistry, molecular simulation and computational prediction.

Organic chemistry.scope: Organic compounds, reaction mechanisms, synthesis, stereochemistry and structure elucidation.

Inorganic chemistry.scope: Inorganic compounds, coordination chemistry, organometallics and solid-state chemistry.

Analytical chemistry.scope: Chemical measurement, separation science, spectroscopy, chromatography and assay validation.

Physical chemistry.scope: Chemical physics, molecular energetics, kinetics, thermodynamics and reaction dynamics.

Thermodynamics.scope: Energy, entropy, phase behaviour, equilibrium and thermodynamic properties of systems.

Fluid mechanics.scope: Fluid statics and dynamics, turbulence, rheology and flow through natural and engineered systems.

Astrobiology.scope: Origins of life, habitability, biosignatures and potential life beyond Earth.

Ecology.scope: Organism-environment relationships, populations, communities, ecosystems and biodiversity.

Evolutionary biology.scope: Evolutionary mechanisms, adaptation, phylogenetics, speciation and population genetics.

Marine science.scope: Oceanography, marine ecosystems, ocean chemistry, marine geology and coastal systems.

Hydrology.scope: Water-cycle processes, surface water, groundwater, catchments and water resources.

Atmospheric science.scope: Atmospheric physics and chemistry, meteorology, weather systems and atmospheric circulation.

Science education.scope: Science learning, STEM pedagogy, curriculum design, assessment and education research.

Technical communication.scope: Technical writing, scientific communication, documentation, information design and knowledge transfer.
